# Cyberfreak Software

Cyberfreak Software Limited is a UK software business providing ongoing SEO Management as its primary service, alongside branded booking website deployments and independent software projects. SEO Management covers Google Search Console monitoring, sitemap-related management, monthly reporting and practical keyword recommendations; content creation, bespoke development and substantial technical work are separately agreed. The website also publishes practical guides on search visibility, website launches, booking journeys and software.

## Main visitor journeys

- [Cyberfreak Software home](https://cyberfreaksoftware.co.uk/): overview of SEO Management, Website Deployments and Software House work; use the site contact dialog to make an enquiry.
- [SEO Management](https://cyberfreaksoftware.co.uk/seo-management/): service scope, monthly reporting, technical configuration and enquiry route.
- [Website Deployments](https://try.cyberfreaksoftware.co.uk/): external CFS booking-website deployment platform.
- [Software House](https://cyberfreaksoftware.co.uk/software-house/): portfolio of platforms, applications and independent projects.
